exposure: persistence of high-risk HPV infections during pregnancy
cohort: 354 pregnant women with positive vaginal HPV infection during the first trimester of pregnancy
finding: Among women with positive vaginal HPV infection in the first trimester, abnormal cytology, other genitourinary infection, multiple HPV genotypes, and persistent high-risk HPV infection were independently associated with placental HPV detection.
mod_finding: HPV was more frequently detected in placentas of women who delivered vaginally compared to those who underwent cesarean section (77/258 vs 1/96).
